props.name: children
props.description: The new element the beacon is attached to. It stays fully usable on its own.

props.name: title
props.description: Name of the feature — the popover's heading and part of the beacon's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences on what it does and why it helps.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional extra link or action, placed before the dismiss button.

props.name: dismissed
props.description: Whether the feature has already been acknowledged. When true only the children render.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on "Got it". Persist it — a beacon that comes back on every visit is noise.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the beacon button. Defaults to "New: {title}".

props.name: corner
props.description: Which corner of the children the dot sits on.
